description: This file defines abstract base classes and mixins for command objects in the Superset project, including methods for owner management and validation.

classes.name: BaseCommand
classes.description: Abstract base class for command objects in Superset, defining run and validate methods.

classes.name: CreateMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing a static method to populate owners, defaulting to current user.

classes.name: UpdateMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing static methods to populate and compute owners for update operations.

methods.name: populate_owners
methods.description: Populate list of owners, defaulting to current user if owner_ids is None or empty.

methods.name: compute_owners
methods.description: Compute final list of owners based on current and new owners.
